prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the approved uploaded face reference for an adult woman, keeping the character's facial structure and likeness consistent without celebrity or public-figure identity language. Dress her in an off-white hollow-out knitted cropped long-sleeve cover-up over a beige tube top, high-waisted retro blue denim shorts with leopard-print plush trim, a dark leather belt, and a brown heart-shaped plush charm. One-take continuous dance with professional choreography: start with feet shoulder-width apart and core engaged; on the first beat, step the right foot sideways, lower the center of gravity, chop the right hand diagonally down from above the head while the left hand rests on the hip, and snap the head with the hand; on the second beat, retract the right foot, circle the hips in a figure-eight, cross hands in front of the chest, then open them to both sides; on the third beat, step the left foot back, lean into a body wave, and comb the hair back; on the fourth beat, shift forward into a lunge, point the right hand toward the lens, and pull the left hand back. Keep fingertips and toes directional, not floppy. Use a fashionable simple indoor stage with warm side light, slight mirror reflection on the floor, cinematic depth of field, and a smooth orbit camera keeping the dancer centered. Render 4K Ultra HD with natural realistic colors, sharp detail, no flicker, normal human body structure, and smooth stable movement.
